def shortest_subarray_ge_target(nums: list[int], target: int) -> int:
    left = 0
    curr_sum = 0
    best = len(nums) + 1
    for right, val in enumerate(nums):
        curr_sum += val
        while curr_sum >= target:
            best = min(best, right - left + 1)
            curr_sum -= nums[left]
            left += 1
    return 0 if best > len(nums) else best
